info.name: 🔥 Fire Alarm - Complete Order Process
info.description:
Complete end-to-end order workflow collection.

## Flow Overview:
1. **Auth** → Login/Register to get JWT token
2. **Browse** → View available packages
3. **Cart** → Add items, update quantities
4. **Checkout** → Convert cart to orders
5. **Payment** → Initiate and complete payment
6. **Track** → View order status
7. **Fulfillment** → Admin assigns devices

## Variables:
- `base_url`: API base URL (https://firealarm.pranisheba.com.bd)
- `access_token`: JWT access token (auto-set on login)
- `refresh_token`: JWT refresh token (auto-set on login)
- `user_id`: Current user's ID (auto-set on login)
- `order_id`: Last created order ID
- `cart_item_id`: Last cart item ID
- `package_id`: Selected package ID

item.name: Step 5b: Bulk Add Items to Cart (Multiple Packages)

request.description:
Add MULTIPLE packages to cart in ONE request.

**Benefits:**
- Reduces API calls (add 10 packages = 1 call instead of 10)
- Atomic operation
- Returns full cart after processing

**Behavior:**
- New package → creates cart item
- Existing package → updates quantity

**Limits:**
- Max 50 items per request
- No duplicate package_ids in same request
